evidence.reason: After edit, returns reminders.historySize() instead of reminders.evaluate(...)/reminders.reminderUnit; test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, which depends on historySize() being positive after reset and evaluate.
New early return for minutes===0 changes behavior for zero input; evaluate forwards to reminderDelay, so scheduledDelay(0) would now return 0 via historySize() path.
scheduledDelay calls evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "benchmark") but tests call evaluate(20, 0.1, "work"); the calendar argument affects reminderDelay's travel branch and possibly other logic.
assert.ok(await scheduledDelay(40) > 0) is the joint behavior relied on; merged edits may violate it if historySize() is 0 after reset/evaluate.

result.userExplanation: 合并后 scheduledDelay 改为返回 historySize() 且日历参数从 "work" 变为 "benchmark"，可能使 scheduledDelay(40) > 0 的测试失败，需确认 reset/evaluate/historySize 的语义。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的返回值，恢复为 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") / reminders.reminderUnit，或确认 historySize() 在 reset 与 evaluate 后仍为正数并保留 "work" 日历参数。
